text:
The failures come from one cause: the core has too little headroom, so its PMOS mirror transistors drop out of saturation at low VDD and at cold.

- **Headroom:** node g1 sits at Veb + Vgs_n ≈ 1.54 V at 27 °C, which leaves M4 only 92 mV of Vds margin. At −40 °C Vbe rises by about 0.13 V, so M4 enters triode. The same happens at the low end of the VDD sweep.
- **Effect:** that is what produces the 438 ppm/°C TC and the 0.45 V/V line regulation.
- **Fix:** tie each NMOS pair transistor's bulk to its own source, which needs a deep N-well in layout. This removes about 0.12 V of body-effect threshold. I also lower I0 and lengthen the PMOS mirrors to raise their output resistance.
- **Prediction models:** I replaced the guessed line-regulation and TC predictions with first-order models.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "M4 (g1 branch) has only 92 mV Vds margin at 27C, so it goes triode at cold and low VDD. That causes the TC and line-regulation failures. Fix: tie the NMOS pair bulks to their sources to remove body effect, lower I0, lengthen the PMOS mirrors, and use physical TC and line-regulation models."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I0":     (4e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),    # PTAT branch current
    "r21":    (9.4, 7.0, 12.0),       # R2/R1 (sets TC / vref)
    "gmid_p": (9, 6, 13),             # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":     (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),        # PMOS mirror L (line regulation)
    "gmid_n": (18, 12, 24),           # NMOS pair gm/Id (weak inv -> low Vgs)
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Ifol":   (3e-6, 1.5e-6, 8e-6),   # follower bias current
    "Vcas":   (0.25, 0.15, 0.35),     # pb - pc
    "Cc":     (5e-12, 1e-12, 15e-12), # dominant-pole cap on node d
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    m3 = 2
    VDD = 1.8
    T = 300.15
    I0 = p["I0"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I0
    R2 = p["r21"] * R1

    # PMOS mirror devices (long L for high ro)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.4)
    pb = VDD - mp.vgs
    mpc = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.35)

    # NMOS pair: bulk tied to source (deep n-well) -> no body effect, lower g1 node
    veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I0 / 10e-6)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I0, vds=0.5, vsb=0.0)

    # Source follower level shift d -> pb
    mf = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, p["Ifol"], vds=VDD - pb, vsb=pb)
    Rtot = pb / p["Ifol"]
    Ra = p["Vcas"] / p["Ifol"]
    Rb = max(Rtot - Ra, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "q2", m=N)
    n.R("R1", "e2", "q2", R1)
    # NMOS common-gate pair, bulk = source (isolated)
    n.dev("M1", "g1", "g1", "e1", "e1", mn)   # diode
    n.dev("M2", "d", "g1", "e2", "e2", mn)
    # PMOS mirror
    n.dev("M4", "g1", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M3", "d", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # follower level shift: pb = d - Vgs(MF)
    n.dev("MF", "vdd", "d", "pb", "vss", mf)
    n.R("RA", "pb", "pc", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "pc", "vss", Rb)
    n.C("CC", "d", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # output branch (cascoded)
    n.dev("M5", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M5C", "vref", "pc", "x", "x", mpc)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=m3)
    # start-up: vref low -> s high -> pull pb low
    n.M("MSP", "s", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSK", "s", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MST", "pb", "s", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5)

    # ---------- predictions ----------
    veb3 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I0 / 10e-6) - UT * math.log(m3)
    VR2 = R2 * I0
    vref = veb3 + VR2
    # first-order TC: dVbe/dT ~ (Vbe - Eg - 3UT)/T, PTAT term VR2/T, + curvature floor
    dvbe = (veb3 - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / T
    dvref = dvbe + VR2 / T
    tc = abs(dvref) / vref * 1e6 + 8.0
    # line regulation: M4 Vsd tracks VDD (error /lnN through PTAT loop),
    # M5 Vsd moves ~Ra/Rtot per volt behind cascode
    gds_id = mp.gm_id / mp.intrinsic_gain
    k5 = Ra / Rtot
    line_reg = VR2 * gds_id * (1.0 / math.log(N) + k5) + 0.5e-3
    i_tot = 3 * I0 + p["Ifol"] + 0.5e-6
    power = VDD * i_tot
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "startup_ok": 1}
```
